data.title: Temperature
data.statement:
Compute the average temperature of days in an input of temperatures. 

- Each day is delimited by a -1. 
- A day can have any number of temperatures, including 0.
- If a day has no temperatures, do not print a temperature average for that day.
- If a temperature is <-500 or greater than 500, do not include it in the final average.
- The end of the input terminates the last day.
data.constraints: The temperatures can be any valid integer.
data.outputDescription: Temperatures for each day separated by newlines, rounded to the nearest integer.

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

Compute the average temperature of days in an input of temperatures.

- Each day is delimited by a -1.
- A day can have any number of temperatures, including 0.
- If a day has no temperatures, do not print a temperature average for that day.
- If a temperature is <-500 or greater than 500, do not include it in the final average.
- The end of the input terminates the last day.
Input
A space-separated list of temperatures.
Output
Temperatures for each day separated by newlines, rounded to the nearest integer.
Constraints
The temperatures can be any valid integer.
Example
Input
10
Output
10
